resources.string: The alerts that pop up over your apps: their sound, without a second banner over the pop-up.
The TV\'s pop-ups on the phone: an alert drops in at the top over whatever app is open, with its drawn card and Watch. Swipe it away left, right or up, or tap it for the game.
Allow Homefield to display over other apps for pop-ups
Tap one to stop it popping up (it still comes as a notification); tap again to bring it back.
